notes.title: Bleeding Roots has translations now!
notes.notes:
[b]It's been one month since the launch of Bleeding Roots on Steam![/b]

We're thrilled to see players from all over the world enjoying the game. It’s been especially popular with our audience in Russia and across Asia, which motivated us to work on enhancing the experience of our players by adding new language options!

Bleeding Roots is now available in Russian, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese!

Thank you for your support!
